description: This is a source Swift file implementing a ContactsService class that provides functionalities to search for and add contacts using the iOS Contacts framework. It handles permissions, normalizes contact data, finds existing contacts based on phone numbers or emails, and formats contact payloads for external use.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A final class providing contact searching and adding functionalities, handling permissions, normalization, and matching of contact data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for contacts based on given parameters, either by name query or all contacts up to a specified limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact with provided parameters, checking for existing contacts with matching phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and manages authorization status for accessing contacts.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Creates and returns an authorized CNContactStore instance, throwing an error if permission is not granted.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Normalizes a list of strings by trimming whitespace and optionally converting to lowercase.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Searches for existing contacts matching provided phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts based on normalized phone numbers and emails, returning the first match.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes phone number strings by extracting digits.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Converts a CNContact object into an OpenClawContactPayload for external use.
